create_TrainingStats: create a TrainingStats instance to track vital training statistics for a detectron model
update_iter_stats: call UpdateIterStats to update tracked iteration statistics including losses and metrics from multi-GPU blobs
log_iter_stats: call LogIterStats to log tracked training statistics as JSON at periodic intervals during SGD iterations
get_stats: call GetStats to retrieve a dictionary of current training stats including loss, ETA, memory usage, and learning rate
reset_iter_timer: call ResetIterTimer to reset the iteration timer for tracking training iteration timing
